openings.claim: Two padded strip pairs gripping only accessible rim surfaces might transfer restraint from seal squeezing to upper-strip-edge stops abutting opposite hatch edges along the pull direction. Drill/trim only strips; withdraw assemblies fully to open; cord-tether assemblies and pads.
openings.discriminator: Against prior G0049:R1's hatch-compression rival: if engagement survives the right-contact card disturbance, replacement should remain within 1 mm under 20 N through ten cycles, reopen within 30 seconds, and cause no new seal tears. At negligible hatch preload it could succeed where the rival slides or lifts a corner. All outcomes are unmeasured.
openings.probe: Before fabrication establish rim access, engagement across disturbed hatch height, and reversible conversion using the same supplies; reject if geometry fails. Prepare both configurations within ninety minutes. Within twenty observation minutes allocate twelve trials: two incumbent diagnostic pulls, one disturbed; then ten numbered replacement cycles, final disturbed. Record position, corner lift, reopening time and seal condition. Compare diagnostic conditions without claiming ten-cycle incumbent validation. Reject seal tears or permanent fixture deformation.
openings.uncertainty: Unspecified geometry must permit independent strip anchoring and opposing contact; no extra bracket/adhesive assumed. Strip stiffness and rim-clamp friction must withstand 20 N without anchor slip/deformation; relocation retains this dependency. Card must not lift hatch beyond engagement. Cord length, clearance and manual release must permit recoverability and unobstructed opening. Failure to prepare both configurations or complete twelve informative trials within supplied time defeats comparison.

lineage.reason: Retains causal replacement, complete rival prediction/probe, declared uncertain fit, dependencies and defeat conditions.

decision: Retain for geometry-and-capacity probing only. Independent rim anchoring remains indispensable and unknown; its failure leaves no established feasible branch.
